text:
# Listing

TL;DR:
- Listing is the main published marketplace item.
- In the current MCP surface, buyer tools return published listing data.
- A listing comes from a draft and references gallery, category, and location.

What it is:
- A listing is the public, published form of an offer on the marketplace.

What it is used for:
- It is the main thing buyers browse, search, inspect, and compare.

Relationships:
- listing <- published from draft
- listing -> gallery
- listing -> category
- listing -> location

Role note:
- In buyer context, listing output can include buyer-specific derived fields such as favourite state, ignore state, thumb state, distance, transaction hints, and ownership state.

Field docs:
- listing.my -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.my
- listing.condition -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.condition
- listing.age -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.age
- listing.priceType -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.priceType
- listing.warranty -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.warranty
- listing.restriction -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.restriction
- listing.delivery -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.delivery
- listing.transactionId -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.transactionId
- listing.location -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.location
- listing.category -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.category
- listing.gallery -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.gallery
- listing.thumb -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.thumb
- listing.draftId -> zbav://mcp/field/listing.draftId

Agent hint:
- Use listing as the core published entity. If the workflow is about preparation before publication, that is draft, not listing.
